prompt_short: Publish my governance vocabulary to OpenMetadata

assertions.text: Response asks for or confirms the .md vocabulary file path
assertions.evidence: SKILL.md Step 1 requires: 'Confirm the .md vocab file path with the user' — an agent following this instruction will ask for or confirm the vocabulary file path before proceeding.

assertions.text: Response references OM_BASE_URL and/or OM_TOKEN environment variables
assertions.evidence: Step 1 explicitly requires verifying 'OM_BASE_URL and OM_TOKEN are set' before running the script — a compliant agent will reference these env vars.
SKILL.md uses JWT token (OM_TOKEN) exclusively for auth; the script invocation in Step 2 uses only the --file argument; no username/password flags appear anywhere in the skill.
